ZSA_SO_PROCESSING_TIME.@EndUserText.label: Sales Order Processing Time
ZSA_SO_PROCESSING_TIME.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT
    "SalesOrder",
    "SoldToParty",
    "SalesOrderDate",

    TO_DATE(
        "SalesOrderDate",
        'YYYYMMDD'
    ) AS "SalesOrderDate_DT",

    YEAR(
        TO_DATE(
            "SalesOrderDate",
            'YYYYMMDD'
        )
    ) AS "SalesOrderYear",

    "SalesOrderType",
    "ReferenceSDDocumentItem",
    "DeliveryDocumentItemText",
    "LastActualGoodsMovementDate",

    DAYS_BETWEEN(
        TO_DATE(
            "SalesOrderDate",
            'YYYYMMDD'
        ),
        "LastActualGoodsMovementDate"
    ) + 1 AS "ProcessingDays",

    CASE
        WHEN "LastActualGoodsMovementDate" IS NULL
            THEN 'MISSING_DELIVERY_DATE'

        WHEN "LastActualGoodsMovementDate" <
             TO_DATE(
                 "SalesOrderDate",
                 'YYYYMMDD'
             )
            THEN 'INVALID_DATE_SEQUENCE'

        ELSE 'VALID'
    END AS "DateValidationStatus"

FROM
(
    SELECT
        "SalesOrder",
        "SoldToParty",
        "SalesOrderDate",
        "SalesOrderType",
        "ReferenceSDDocumentItem",
        "DeliveryDocumentItemText",

        MAX(
            TO_DATE(
                "ActualGoodsMovementDate",
                'YYYYMMDD'
            )
        ) AS "LastActualGoodsMovementDate"

    FROM "ZSA_HA_SO_DELIVERY_DETAIL"

    WHERE "OverallTotalDeliveryStatus" = 'C'
      AND "OverallGoodsMovementStatus" = 'C'

      AND "SalesOrderDate" IS NOT NULL
      AND "SalesOrderDate" <> ''
      AND "SalesOrderDate" <> '00000000'

      AND "ActualGoodsMovementDate" IS NOT NULL
      AND "ActualGoodsMovementDate" <> ''
      AND "ActualGoodsMovementDate" <> '00000000'

    GROUP BY
        "SalesOrder",
        "SoldToParty",
        "SalesOrderDate",
        "SalesOrderType",
        "ReferenceSDDocumentItem",
        "DeliveryDocumentItemText"

) AS "ORDER_LAST_DELIVERY"
